title: Descent and continuity for the element-site presentation
statement: Let C be a small site with topology J [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and A a sheaf of sets. Use the element projection p, topology J_A and fibre functor defined in [lem-weil-pbc-element-module-extension-adjunction]. Then J_A equals p.restrictedTopology(J), p is cocontinuous, and there exists an equivalence Sh(J_A) ≃ Sh(J)/A whose inverse after forgetting to presheaves is naturally isomorphic to the fibre functor (F → A) ↦ ((U,s) ↦ {x in F(U) : p(x)=s}). For every sheaf B and map b:B → A, the induced element-site map is continuous.

proof.text: Lift every arrow v:V→U uniquely below (U,s) to (V,A(v)s)→(U,s). Sieves below these objects identify with sieves below U, compatibly with pullback and transitivity. The resulting topology is restrictedTopology, and precomposition preserves sheaves, so Mathlib restrictedTopology_eq_inducedTopology identifies it with J_A. Lift covering sieves to prove cocontinuity. Fibre sections glue uniquely in F; their images agree with s by separatedness of A. Conversely pairs (s,x) glue by first gluing s in A and then x on the lifted element cover. The maps x↦(p(x),x) and fibre evaluation give inverse natural isomorphisms, including all restrictions. A sheaf map B→A carries lifted covering families to lifted covering families and preserves this sheaf gluing condition, giving continuity of the element map. Empty fibres and empty covers satisfy the same sheaf condition.

lean.statement:
theorem element_site_descent
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (A : Sheaf J (Type u)) :
    elementTopology A = (elementProjection A).restrictedTopology J ∧
    Functor.IsCocontinuous (elementProjection A) (elementTopology A) J ∧
    (∃ e : Sheaf (elementTopology A) (Type u) ≌
        CostructuredArrow (𝟭 (Sheaf J (Type u))) A,
      Nonempty (e.inverse ⋙ sheafToPresheaf (elementTopology A) (Type u) ≅
        elementFibrePresheafFunctor A)) ∧
    (∀ (B : Sheaf J (Type u)) (b : B ⟶ A),
      Functor.IsContinuous (elementMap b) (elementTopology B) (elementTopology A))
